questions.question: What is the role of the Maria Lopez who presented the grants budget on 12 May 2025?

chunks.quote: Maria Lopez presented the grants budget for 2025-26.

questions.note: The minutes name her team; the staff record of that Maria Lopez gives the role. The other Maria Lopez is a postdoctoral researcher.

questions.question: Which team is the person who kept the Aldmoor bog field log in?

chunks.quote: Aldmoor bog field log, winter 2024-25, kept by M. Lopez.
Maria Lopez of the Soil Ecology team received this year's Hensley Field-Work Award for her peat sampling campaign on the Aldmoor bog

questions.note: "M. Lopez" could be either Maria Lopez; only the Soil Ecology one ran the Aldmoor campaign.

questions.question: In how many documents does Jonathan Pike appear, under any form of his name?

chunks.quote: J. Pike explained the equipment overrun
Dr. Jonathan Pike chaired the session
Dr Jonathan Pike of the environmental institute

questions.note: Changed in version 2 of the corpus (R73), before any output on it: 4 -> 8. Spellings of one person: Dr. Jonathan Pike, Jon Pike, J. Pike, Dr. J. Pike, Dr Jonathan Pike. Judith Pike (a letter about Harbour Street) is someone else; the staff record is not a document.

questions.question: Who says the Mill Lane footbridge is safe to use?

chunks.quote: Mayor Helen Achterberg said the footbridge "is safe to use until the works begin".

questions.note: The article reports the mayor's claim; the inspector recommended closing the bridge, and the letter writer disputes the mayor.

questions.question: Which team does the Maria Lopez who presented a poster at the Utrecht peat conference belong to?

chunks.quote: Maria Lopez presented a poster on the 240 cores of the Aldmoor bog
The trip of Maria Lopez (Soil Ecology) to the peat conference in Utrecht

questions.note: Three people are called Maria Lopez in the corpus: the Soil Ecology researcher, the grants accountant who wrote the travel memo, and a baker on Harbour Street.

questions.question: Which team does the person who chaired the committee meeting of 9 June 2025 belong to?
questions.note: Jon Pike chaired the meeting of 12 May (G04); the chair of 9 June is Aiko Tanaka.

questions.question: Who claims that a Hydra P-40 needs a new mechanical seal every 18 months of duty?

chunks.quote: In our experience a Hydra P-40 needs a new mechanical seal every 18 months of duty.
Ines Barros, Service Manager, Calder Pumps

questions.note: A vendor's claim in its own letter; the utility's documents never state it.
